why: D-451 — queue row 0 item 7: worldgen must never drop items during generation. Over a real generated region it asserts zero calls ever reach EntityList.popResource/dropStack during gen (they do not — every 04*.js write goes through Features.setBlock, a REFUSAL gate, not a write-then-break), then an anti-vacuity section monkeypatches Features.api.setBlock to simulate the hypothesised bug and confirms the assertion would fail against it. After featcheck because it drives the same feature-placement pipeline.
